arxiv-2104-10662.title: COVID-19 sentiment analysis via deep learning during the rise of novel cases
arxiv-2104-10662.creator: Rohitash Chandra
arxiv-2104-10662.description: Abstract \AppendGraphicsExtensions .tiff Abstract Social scientists and psychologists take interest in understanding how people express emotions and sentiments when dealing with catastrophic events such as natural disasters, political unrest, and terrorism. The COVID-19 pandemic is a catastrophic event that has raised a number of psychological issues such as depression given abrupt social changes and lack of employment.

arxiv-2108-04407.title: Reynolds n n -Lie algebras and NS- n n -Lie algebras
arxiv-2108-04407.creator: Shuai Hou, Yunhe Sheng
arxiv-2108-04407.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shuai Hou, Yunhe Sheng. In this paper, first we introduce the notion of a Reynolds operator on an n n -Lie algebra and illustrate the relationship between Reynolds operators and derivations on an n n -Lie algebra. We give the cohomology theory of Reynolds operators on an n n -Lie algebra and study infinitesimal deformations of Reynolds operators using the second cohomology group.

arxiv-2205-10875.title: On an elastic strain-limiting special Cosserat rod model
arxiv-2205-10875.creator: K. R. Rajagopal and C. Rodriguez
arxiv-2205-10875.description: Abstract . Motivated by recent strain-limiting models for solids and biological fibers, we introduce the first intrinsic set of nonlinear constitutive relations, between the geometrically exact strains and the components of the contact force and contact couple, describing a uniform, hyperelastic, strain-limiting special Cosserat rod.

arxiv-2206-10528.title: A quantum information perspective on meson melting
arxiv-2206-10528.creator: Mari Carmen Bañuls, Michal P. Heller, Karl Jansen, Johannes Knaute, Viktor Svensson
arxiv-2206-10528.description: Abstract We propose to use quantum information notions to characterize thermally induced melting of nonperturbative bound states at high temperatures. We apply tensor networks to investigate this idea in static and dynamical settings within the Ising quantum field theory, where bound states are confined fermion pairs – mesons.

arxiv-2407-03291.title: VCHAR:Variance-Driven Complex Human Activity Recognition framework with Generative Representation Journal: IMWUT Volume: 0 0 0 0 CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning CCS: Human-centered computing Visualization
arxiv-2407-03291.creator: YUAN SUN, NAVID SALAMI PARGOO, TAQIYA EHSAN, ZHAO ZHANG, JORGE ORTIZ
arxiv-2407-03291.description: Abstract . Complex human activity recognition (CHAR) remains a pivotal challenge within ubiquitous computing, especially in the context of smart environments. Existing studies typically require meticulous labeling of both atomic and complex activities, a task that is labor-intensive and prone to errors due to the scarcity and inaccuracies of available datasets.

arxiv-2410-07398.title: Intense star cluster formation: stellar masses, the mass function, and the fundamental mass scale
arxiv-2410-07398.creator: Christopher D. Matzner
arxiv-2410-07398.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christopher D. Matzner. Within the birth environment of a massive globular cluster, the combination of a luminous young stellar population and a high column density induces a state in which the thermal optical depth and radiation pressure are both appreciable. In this state, the sonic mass scale, which influences the peak of the stellar mass function, is tied to a fundamental scale composed of the Planck mass and the mass per particle.

arxiv-2410-22337.description: Abstract . In this paper, we improve, complement and generalize (from Nörlund to matrix transform means) a result of Móricz and Siddiqi [ 26 ] and some statements of Areshidze and Tephnadze [ 3 ] , and (from T T (weighted) to matrix transform means) Anakidze, Areshidze, Persson and Tephnadze [ 2 ] . 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification 42C10 1.

arxiv-2506-19869.title: Modeling Transmission Dynamics of Tuberculosis: Parameter Estimation and Sensitivity Analysis Using Real-World Data
arxiv-2506-19869.creator: Moksina Seyid, Abdu Mohammed Seid, Yassin Tesfaw Abebe
arxiv-2506-19869.description: Abstract Tuberculosis (TB) continues to pose a major public health challenge, particularly in high-burden regions such as Ethiopia, necessitating a more profound understanding of its transmission dynamics. In this study, we developed an SVEITRS compartmental model to investigate the transmission dynamics of TBs, utilizing real data from Ethiopia from 2011–2021.

arxiv-2507-20936.title: Dissecting Persona-Driven Reasoning in Language Models via Activation Patching
arxiv-2507-20936.creator: Ansh Poonia, Maeghal Jain
arxiv-2507-20936.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable versatility in adopting diverse personas. In this study, we examine how assigning a persona influences a model’s reasoning on an objective task. Using activation patching, we take a first step toward understanding how key components of the model encode persona-specific information.

pmc-10694140.creator: Hsiao-Huai Kuo, Yau-Huei Lai, Po-Lin Lin, Hsin-Hao Chen, Chung-Lieh Hung, Lawrence Yu-Min Liu, Chih-Kuang Yeh
pmc-10694140.description: Sodium-glucose cotransporter type 2 (SGLT2) inhibitors have demonstrated to reduce cardiovascular risk in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) in large trials independent of glycemic control. The mechanisms of this cardioprotective property remain uncertain. Evidence suggests positive hemodynamic changes and favorable cardiac remodeling contributing to the clinical outcomes but results were conflicting.

pmc-12681885.title: Extraction of the polysorbate 20 and 80 fingerprint via generative modeling
pmc-12681885.creator: Peter Roelants, Reza Ranjbar Choubeh, Nico Verbeeck, Rabindranath Andujar, Torsten Schultz-Fademrecht, Patrick Garidel, Viktor Gross
pmc-12681885.description: Polysorbate 20 (PS20) and polysorbate 80 (PS80) are essential surfactants used to stabilize biopharmaceutical products, yet their highly heterogeneous mixtures and susceptibility to oxidation and enzymatic hydrolysis complicate routine analysis. We developed a hierarchical generative model that reconstructs entire liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC–MS) measurements to automatically interpret complex polysorbate datasets.

pmc-13214451.creator: Zixiong Nie, Longrong Bian, Honghua Yue, Weitao Liang, Zhong Wu
pmc-13214451.description: BackgroundInfectious pseudoaneurysms are rare, and those caused by Cryptococcus, an organism commonly found in pigeon feces, are exceptionally uncommon. This case highlights this severe vascular complication as a sequel of cryptococcal infection.Case presentationA 71-year-old male with a history of pigeon exposure presented with a persistent fever and was diagnosed with cryptococcal pneumonia and bacteremia.
